llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam indicators: it impersonates the legitimate UGG brand, lists UGG boots at highly unrealistic prices (e.g., €55, vastly below market value), offers free shipping and returns on all orders (common scam tactic), lacks any verifiable business details or Austrian registration, uses generic about page text, and does not show ownership transparency. Additionally, the content appears copied and targeted at exploiting consumer interest in discounted branded goods, and the official WHOIS data is concealed.
